meta.requirement: Explore Whispering Woods (1%+ exploration) to trigger this quest.

customTabs.label: tip
customTabs.content:
You can click the '''Collapse''' button and the '''Best Route''' → '''Important Only''' button at the top to minimize it.
''Some quests will not have a Best Route choice, because the best choice is subjective or not yet found.''

You can also click the '''Endings''' button at the top to view all possible endings, and clicking an ending will show the options needed to reach that ending.

start.title: Flowers for Marla
start.text:
''You see an adventurer with a broken leg, bleeding uncontrollably, unable to walk, and scramble over to help''.

Thomas: Traveller! ''cough, cough'' I am running out of time.

whthpnd.text: Thomas: I came out yonder before supper. My lovely wife, Marla, hasn't come home yet. She's been busy with work these past few weeks and comes back late. I wanted to surprise her with some of these beautiful flowers, but a gang of Hilichurls got in the way.

ruok.text: Thomas: As you can see, traveller, this is the end for me. But could you do me a favour?

ofc.text: Thomas: Here, take these flowers back to our place in Mondstadt City. Please bring them to Marla at least. She is probably home by now. I will rest here and watch the stars until the heavenly principles take me.

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Deliver the Golden Poppy to Marla in Mondstadt City

mlrshs.text: ''You knock on the door, but no one answers''.

knckagn.text:
''You knock on the door again. An old, tall, and muscular figure answers''.

Carter: Who are you and what do you want?

lookn4marl.text: Carter: Marla? What business do you have with my fiancée?

choices.label: I'm here to deliver her something
Sorry, I got the wrong person

wrgprsn.text:
Carter: Hmph. Be on your way, then.

''The door shuts''.

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Return to Thomas in the Whispering Woods

rtrnthms_best.text: ''You return to where you left Thomas, but he has already passed away while waiting beneath the stars''.

choices.label: Make a grave and plant the flowers

ending_mqu8kyiv.title: Bury Thomas with Flowers
ending_mqu8kyiv.text: ''You dig a grave and lay Thomas to rest, planting the Golden Poppy on his resting place. Somewhere in Mondstadt, Marla waits for a husband who will never return home''.

dlvrsmth.text:
Carter: Very well. ''He calls up the stairs''. Marla, someone is here for you.

''Marla comes down to the door''.
Marla: Yes? Can I help you, traveller?

flwrfrmthms.text:
''You offer the flowers and mention they are from Thomas''.

Carter: Thomas? Who in the world is Thomas?

mrladed.text: ''Carter's face twists with rage. A vicious fight breaks out, and when the dust settles, Marla lies dead on the floor. You flee into the night''.

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Return to Thomas in the Whispering Woods

ending_mqu9iqe1.title: Flowers Delivered
ending_mqu9iqe1.text:
Marla: For me? How thoughtful. Thank you, traveller.

''She smiles warmly and closes the door''.

burythomasbad.text: ''You return to where you left Thomas, but he has already passed. His body lies cold beneath the trees, his eyes still turned to the stars''.

choices.label: Make a grave and plant the flowers

ending_mqu9o6md.title: Marla Dies
ending_mqu9o6md.text: ''You dig a grave and lay Thomas to rest, planting the Golden Poppy atop the fresh earth. He will never learn what became of Marla, and perhaps that is a mercy''.
